# intenter history

Show what Intenter decided, and why

Lists the most recent decisions across every project: the command, what it
resolved to, the decision (allow, ask, block) and the rule or approval that
decided it. Filters narrow by decision, project, agent session or age. Use
`intenter history show <event-id>` for the full explanation of one event.

## Usage

```text
intenter history [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter history
intenter history --blocked --since 24h
intenter history --project ~/src/app --limit 50 --json
```

## Subcommands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`intenter history show`](intenter_history_show.md) | Explain one decision in full |

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--allowed` | — | only allowed commands |
| `--asked` | — | only commands that needed confirmation |
| `--blocked` | — | only blocked commands |
| `--limit` `<int>` | `50` | how many events to show |
| `--project` `<string>` | — | only this project directory |
| `--session` `<string>` | — | only this agent session |
| `--since` `<duration>` | `0s` | only events newer than this duration, e.g. 24h |

| Flag | Default | What it does |
